name: Manjistha
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; the powder is mixed with honey or rose water as a face pack, or taken as powder or decoction.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: It can turn urine reddish; this is harmless.

cautions.note: Not enough is known; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
Related madder species contain compounds of concern for long-term use; avoid with kidney disease.

evidence.summary: Laboratory and animal studies only; no reliable trials in people.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
